next.reason: 1985: 'The format 2 REPLACE statement specifies that any text replacement currently in effect is discontinued.' 2023 keeps that for format 2 without LAST (§2023:7.2.4.4 GR7 d) 'cancels the active REPLACE statement and cancels all REPLACE statements in the queue'; GR6 b) no effect when none active; GR4 c) canceled) but adds REPLACE LAST OFF, accepted in 2023 and refused in 1985: §2023:7.2.4.4 GR7 c) 'A format 2 REPLACE statement with the LAST phrase cancels the active REPLACE statement and pops the last statement that was pushed into the queue', which re-activates replacement instead of discontinuing it.
